title: From Lab to Field: Real-World Evaluation of an AI-Driven Smart Video Solution to Enhance Community Safety
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith/religion. It evaluates the performance of an AI-driven video surveillance system.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion. Its focus is on the technical evaluation of an AI-driven video surveillance system for community safety, measuring metrics like latency, throughput, and anomaly detection accuracy.
